cache_state: prepared: factor-base logs ready before the online clock
collection_law: W = 256 walks R_i = [k0]G + i [a]G with (k0, a) drawn from collection_stream
prng: CPython random.Random seeded with the string (version-2 seeding)
rerandomization_law: a0 = first randrange(1, r) of rerandomization_stream; attempts Q + i [a0]G

rho_floor.rule: rho on classes {+-tau^j P}, sqrt(pi r / (4 n)); not implemented here

rho_law: 32-entry r-adding walk T_j = [c_j]G + e_j Q (e_j in {0, 1}, 16 each), W starts [a_w]G + Q, distinguished points (x >> 8) mod 2^dp_bits = 0; [c_j]G and [a_w]G are target-independent and computed before the rho clock

rho_reference.rule: expected parallel rho without equivalence classes, sqrt(pi r / 2)
